summaryEn: Today's papers explore major frontiers in AI evaluation, multimodal perception, and model training stability. Key highlights include Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench for testing long-range terminal agents, GenCeption exploring video generation models as general vision learners, and visual pretraining methods that directly leverage visually rich documents.
summaryZh: 今日论文探索了AI评估、多模态感知和模型训练稳定性等领域的前沿进展。重点研究包括用于测试长程终端任务智能体的Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench、将视频生成模型作为通用视觉学习器的GenCeption，以及直接利用丰富视觉文档的视觉预训练方法。

papers.titleEn: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench: Testing the Limits of Agents on Long-Horizon Terminal Tasks with Dense Reward-Based Grading
papers.titleZh: Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench：基于密集奖励分级的长程终端任务智能体极限测试
papers.problemEn: Existing terminal benchmarks largely focus on simple tasks that finish within minutes and evaluate only the final outcome, resulting in sparse rewards and an incomplete assessment of agent capabilities on complex, open-ended workflows.
papers.problemZh: 现有的终端任务基准测试主要集中在几分钟内即可完成的简单任务上，且仅通过最终结果进行评估，导致奖励信号稀疏，难以全面评估智能体在复杂、开放式工作流中的能力。
papers.innovationEn: Introduces a benchmark of 46 long-horizon tasks across 9 categories (e.g., experiment reproduction, software engineering) decomposed into fine-grained graded subtasks to provide dense intermediate rewards and partial credit.
papers.innovationZh: 引入了一个包含9个类别、46个长程任务的基准，将其分解为细粒度的分级子任务，从而提供密集的中间奖励和部分评分。
papers.resultEn: Evaluations of 15 frontier models show they consume an average of 9.9M tokens, 231 episodes, and 85.3 minutes per run, with the strongest model achieving only 15.2% pass@1 at a 0.95 partial reward threshold, revealing significant room for improvement.
papers.resultZh: 对15个前沿模型的评估表明，每次运行平均消耗990万个token、进行231个回合、执行85.3分钟；在0.95的部分奖励阈值下，最强模型的pass@1仅为15.2%，表明有巨大的提升空间。

papers.titleEn: Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners
papers.titleZh: 视频生成模型是通用视觉学习器
papers.problemEn: Finding a general-purpose pretraining catalyst in computer vision equivalent to next-token prediction in natural language processing.
papers.problemZh: 在计算机视觉中寻找一种通用的预训练催化剂，以等效于自然语言处理中的下一个Token预测。
papers.innovationEn: Contends that large-scale text-to-video generation serves as a strong pretraining paradigm, and introduces GenCeption, which leverages a pretrained video generative diffusion backbone to define a feed-forward perception model capable of performing various vision tasks steered by text instructions.
papers.innovationZh: 主张大规模文本到视频生成可以作为一种强大的预训练范式，并引入了GenCeption，利用预训练的视频生成扩散骨干来定义一个前馈感知模型，该模型能够执行由文本指令引导的各种感知任务。
papers.resultEn: GenCeption achieves state-of-the-art performance in depth, surface normal, and pose estimation, showing extreme data efficiency (requiring 7x to 500x less training data) and generalizing from synthetic to real-world out-of-distribution categories.
papers.resultZh: GenCeption在深度、表面法线和姿态估计方面达到了先进水平，表现出极高的数据效率（所需训练数据减少了7到500倍），并能从合成数据泛化到真实世界的分布外类别。

papers.titleEn: Scalable Visual Pretraining for Language Intelligence
papers.titleZh: 面向语言智能的可扩展视觉预训练
papers.problemEn: Traditional language pretraining discards rich visual cues like figures, typeset equations, and page layouts by converting visually rich documents and web pages into plain text.
papers.problemZh: 传统的语言预训练通过将视觉信息丰富的文档和网页转换为纯文本，丢弃了诸如插图、排版公式和页面布局等丰富的视觉线索。
papers.innovationEn: Challenges the text-only pretraining assumption and systematically studies unsupervised visual pretraining paradigms that directly leverage visual documents without text extraction.
papers.innovationZh: 挑战了仅使用文本预训练的假设，系统研究了直接利用视觉文档而无需文本提取的无监督视觉预训练范式。
papers.resultEn: Visual pretraining on the same underlying corpora consistently outperforms text-only pretraining across multiple backbones and benchmarks, offering an efficient pathway to scalable language intelligence.
papers.resultZh: 在相同的底层语料库上，跨多个骨干网络和基准测试的视觉预训练始终优于仅文本的预训练，为实现可扩展的语言智能提供了一条高效途径。

papers.titleEn: KronQ: LLM Quantization via Kronecker-Factored Hessian
papers.titleZh: KronQ：基于克罗内克分解海森矩阵的大语言模型量化
papers.problemEn: Existing second-order post-training quantization (PTQ) methods assume all output channels contribute equally to reconstruction loss by using only input activation statistics, leading to divergence in ultra-low bit scenarios.
papers.problemZh: 现有的二阶训练后量化（PTQ）方法仅使用输入激活统计量，假设所有输出通道对重构损失的贡献相同，这导致在超低比特场景下量化发散。
papers.innovationEn: Proposes KronQ, introducing gradient covariance into the quantization pipeline under Kronecker-factored Hessian approximation, using bidirectional incoherence processing and a new sensitivity metric for inter-layer mixed-precision allocation.
papers.innovationZh: 提出了KronQ，在克罗内克分解的海森矩阵近似下将梯度协方差引入量化管道，采用双向不相干处理以及用于层间混合精度分配的新敏感度指标。
papers.resultEn: For LLaMA-3-70B 2-bit weight-only quantization, where GPTQ and GPTAQ diverge (perplexity > 2000), KronQ achieves a stable perplexity of 7.93 on WikiText-2.
papers.resultZh: 对于LLaMA-3-70B的2比特仅权重化，在GPTQ and GPTAQ均发散（困惑度 > 2000）的情况下，KronQ在WikiText-2上实现了7.93的稳定困惑度。

papers.problemEn: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is notoriously unstable and suffers from high variance, making it hard to train language models reliably on complex reasoning tasks.
papers.problemZh: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）极不稳定且方差较大，这使得在复杂推理任务上可靠地训练语言模型变得非常困难。
papers.innovationEn: Presents Trust Region Policy Distillation (TOP-D), which stabilizes OPD by dynamically constructing a proximal teacher, providing global convergence analysis and monotonic improvement bounds without adding computational overhead.
papers.innovationZh: 提出了信赖域策略蒸馏（TOP-D），通过动态构建近端教师来稳定OPD，在不增加额外计算开销的情况下提供了全局收敛性分析和单调提升界限。
papers.resultEn: TOP-D dramatically enhances training stability, sample efficiency, and final performance on mathematical reasoning tasks with zero extra computational cost.
papers.resultZh: TOP-D以零额外计算开销，显著提升了数学推理任务的训练稳定性、样本效率和最终性能。

papers.titleEn: From RGB Generation to Dense Field Readout: Pixel-Space Dense Prediction with Text-to-Image Models
papers.titleZh: 从RGB生成到稠密场读取：基于文本到图像模型的像素空间稠密预测
papers.problemEn: Casting dense prediction (depth, normals, segmentation) as target image generation via diffusion models inherits the unnecessary complexity of the generative output interface (decoding back to RGB), slowing down inference and losing pixel-correctness.
papers.problemZh: 通过扩散模型将稠密预测（深度、法线、分割）视为目标图像生成，继承了生成式输出接口（解码回RGB）不必要的复杂性，降低了推理速度并丢失了像素准确性。
papers.innovationEn: Introduces ReChannel, which drops the target-side VAE decoder, adapts a frozen Diffusion Transformer (FLUX-Klein) with task LoRA, and directly maps tokens to task-native patch channels via a local linear head.
papers.innovationZh: 引入了ReChannel，丢弃了目标侧的VAE解码器，使用任务LoRA微调冻结的扩散Transformer（FLUX-Klein），并通过局部线性头部直接将Token映射到任务特有的Patch通道。
papers.resultEn: ReChannel sets new state-of-the-art results on trimap-free matting, KITTI depth, and referring segmentation, running 2.48x faster and with higher accuracy than edit-plus-latent-decode counterparts.
papers.resultZh: ReChannel在无Trimap抠图、KITTI深度和指代分割任务上创下了新的先进水平，速度比传统的“编辑加潜在解码”方法快2.48倍，且精度更高。

papers.titleEn: Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large Language Model Finetuning
papers.titleZh: 从机制上理解为什么大语言模型微调中记忆的知识无法泛化
papers.problemEn: LLMs fine-tuned to inject new knowledge can easily memorize new facts but often fail to apply them for downstream reasoning tasks, a phenomenon termed the Knowing-Using Gap.
papers.problemZh: 为了注入新知识而微调的大语言模型很容易记住新事实，但往往无法在下游推理任务中应用它们，这种现象被称为“知用差距”（Knowing-Using Gap）。
papers.innovationEn: Monitors spatial permeation dynamics of unseen knowledge internally via a new 'self-patching' intervention technique, identifying activation locations where relocated representations improve generalization.
papers.innovationZh: 通过一种名为“自我修补”（self-patching）的新型干预技术，在模型内部监测未知知识的空间渗透动态，识别出重新定位表示后能改善泛化的激活位置。
papers.resultEn: Validates the knowledge-circuit misalignment hypothesis and designs a simple heuristic strategy that recovers 58-75% of the oracle headroom in generalization failures.
papers.resultZh: 验证了知识电路失配假说，并设计了一种简单的启发式策略，挽回了泛化失败中58%至75%的理想上限空间。

papers.titleZh: PanoWorld：真实世界全景视频生成
papers.problemEn: Generating consistent, long-range panoramic videos requires modeling camera trajectories over complex spatial variations and illumination changes without collapsing details.
papers.problemZh: 生成一致的长程全景视频，需要对复杂空间变化和光照变化下的相机轨迹进行建模，同时避免细节丢失。
papers.innovationEn: Proposes PanoWorld, which simplifies trajectories into fixed-heading translations and uses Dense Panoramic Ray-Conditioning (DPRC) and Geometry-aware Memory Augmentation (GMA) to generate panoramic views.
papers.innovationZh: 提出了PanoWorld，将相机轨迹简化为固定朝向的平移，并使用稠密全景射线条件反射（DPRC）和几何感知记忆增强（GMA）来生成全景视图。
papers.resultEn: Evaluated on a new dataset World360 (drone and AirSim360 clips), PanoWorld outperforms alternative methods by a large margin on physical consistency.
papers.resultZh: 在包含无人机和AirSim360片段的新数据集World360上进行评估，PanoWorld在物理一致性上大幅优于其他方法。

papers.titleEn: Self-Guided Test-Time Training for Long-Context LLMs
papers.titleZh: 面向长文本大语言模型的自我引导测试时训练
papers.problemEn: Simply extending context windows does not guarantee effective evidence utilization; applying Test-Time Training (TTT) to the entire long context is expensive, while training on random spans introduces noise.
papers.problemZh: 仅延长上下文窗口并不能保证有效利用证据；将测试时训练（TTT）应用于整个长上下文成本太高，而在随机跨度上训练会引入噪声。
papers.innovationEn: Proposes Self-Guided TTT (S-TTT), where the model first identifies the evidence spans to learn from and then applies the language-modeling training objective only to those selected spans.
papers.innovationZh: 提出了自我引导测试时训练（S-TTT），模型首先识别要学习的证据跨度，然后仅在这些选定跨度上应用语言模型训练目标。
papers.resultEn: Improves long-context reasoning benchmarks (LongBench-v2 and LongBench-Pro) for Qwen3 and Llama-3.1 models, achieving up to a 15% relative improvement.
papers.resultZh: 提升了Qwen3和Llama-3.1模型在长上下文推理基准测试（LongBench-v2和LongBench-Pro）上的表现，实现了高达15%的相对改进。

papers.titleEn: Flow-ERD: Agent-type Aware Flow Matching with Entropy-Regularized Distillation for Diverse Traffic Simulation
papers.titleZh: Flow-ERD：智能体类型感知的流匹配与熵正则化蒸馏的多样化交通流模拟
papers.problemEn: Traffic simulation benchmarks reward realism while leaving motion diversity underexplored, causing models to collapse onto high-density modes and suffer from covariate shift.
papers.problemZh: 交通模拟基准测试奖励真实性，但对运动多样性的探索不足，导致模型塌陷到高密度模式并遭受协变量偏移。
papers.innovationEn: Introduces Flow-ERD, using Agent-Type Aware Flow Matching (AFM) for type-specific kinematics, and Entropy-Regularized Distillation (ERD) with a reverse-KL objective to prevent mode collapse during rollouts.
papers.innovationZh: 引入了Flow-ERD，使用智能体类型感知流匹配（AFM）来进行特定类型的运动学处理，并结合反向KL目标的熵正则化蒸馏（ERD）来防止滚动中的模式崩塌。
papers.resultEn: Ranks first on the WOSAC test benchmark and dominates the realism-diversity Pareto front among reproducible baselines.
papers.resultZh: 在WOSAC测试基准上排名第一，并在可复现的基线模型中主导了真实性-多样性的帕累托前沿。

papers.titleEn: Phone Segmentation and Recognition through Phonological Activation Mapping
papers.titleZh: 基于音系激活映射的音素分割与识别
papers.problemEn: Speech phone segmentation and recognition are inherently related, but modern methods model them separately and require extensive annotations.
papers.problemZh: 语音音素分割和识别本质上是相关的，但现代方法将它们分开建模且需要大量的标注。
papers.innovationEn: Uses S3M-based Phonological Activation Mapping (SPAM) to map speech frames to feature vectors like voicing, adding lightweight, gradient-free recognition and segmentation heads.
papers.innovationZh: 使用基于S3M的音系激活映射（SPAM）将语音帧映射到浊音度、鼻音度等特征向量，并添加了轻量级、无梯度的识别和分割头部。
papers.resultEn: Achieves strong segmentation and recognition performance on multiple datasets while requiring less than a minute of phonetic transcriptions and generalizing to unseen phones.
papers.resultZh: 在多个数据集上取得了强大的分割和识别性能，同时仅需不足一分钟的音素转录，并能泛化到训练中未见过的音素。

papers.titleEn: MedPMC: A Systematic Framework for Scaling High-Fidelity Medical Multimodal Data for Foundation Models
papers.titleZh: MedPMC：面向基础模型扩展高保真医学多模态数据的系统框架
papers.problemEn: The development of medical multimodal foundation models is limited by the scarcity of high-quality, clinically validated, and reproducible image-text clinical datasets.
papers.problemZh: 医学多模态基础模型的发展受限于高质量、临床验证且可复现的图像-文本临床数据集的稀缺。
papers.innovationEn: Introduces MedPMC, an automated framework that curates literature from PubMed Central (PMC), screening and classifying 11 million high-fidelity medical image-text pairs with high F1 scores.
papers.innovationZh: 引入了MedPMC，这是一个自动化框架，可以从PubMed Central（PMC）中筛选文献，以高F1分数筛选并分类出1100万个高保真医学图像-文本对。
papers.resultEn: A MedPMC-trained CLIP model improves zero-shot AUC by 7.1 percentage points over biomedical CLIP baselines, and enhances VQA benchmarks and dermatology retrieval tasks.
papers.resultZh: 在MedPMC上训练的CLIP模型在零样本AUC上比生物医学CLIP基线提高了7.1个百分点，并提升了视觉问答（VQA）基准和皮肤科图像检索任务的表现。

papers.titleEn: A Sovereign, Open-Source Foundation Model for German and English
papers.titleZh: 一个面向德语和英语的主权开源基础模型
papers.problemEn: European sovereign AI needs high-performance, open-source models optimized for local languages like German without sacrificing general throughput or scaling capabilities.
papers.problemZh: 欧洲主权AI需要针对德语等本地语言优化的高性能、开源模型，同时又不能牺牲常规吞吐量或扩展能力。
papers.innovationEn: Presents Soofi S 30B-A3B, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) activating 3B parameters per token, trained on 27 trillion tokens with up-weighted German on sovereign HPC infrastructure.
papers.innovationZh: 展示了Soofi S 30B-A3B，这是一个混合了Mamba和Transformer的专家混合（MoE）模型，每个Token仅激活30B参数中的3B，在主权HPC基础设施上以提升的德语权重训练了27万亿个token。
papers.resultEn: Matches dense 14-27B models on English/German benchmarks, outperforming European sovereign baselines, Olmo 3, and Apertus 70B, with fully open weights and data accounting.
papers.resultZh: 在英文/德文基准测试中媲美14-27B的稠密模型，性能超越欧洲主权基线模型、Olmo 3和Apertus 70B，并完全开源权重和数据账目。

papers.titleEn: VaseMuseum: Digital Intelligent Museum for Ancient Greek Pottery
papers.titleZh: VaseMuseum：古希腊陶器数字智能博物馆
papers.problemEn: VLMs in cultural heritage domains hallucinate or give overconfident answers when visual evidence is incomplete, and lack grounding in authoritative curatorial knowledge.
papers.problemZh: 在文化遗产领域，当视觉证据不完整时，视觉语言模型（VLM）容易产生幻觉或给出过度自信的回答，且缺乏权威馆藏知识的支撑。
papers.innovationEn: Proposes VaseMuseum, a modular agent framework using VaseAgent with multimodal 2D/3D perception, authoritative external knowledge retrieval, and inference-time GRPO-style reliability control.
papers.innovationZh: 提出了VaseMuseum，这是一个模块化智能体框架，利用VaseAgent进行多模态2D/3D感知、权威外部知识检索，以及推理时基于GRPO风格的可靠性控制。
papers.resultEn: Significantly improves citation validity and reduces hallucinations in knowledge-intensive queries compared with standard search-enabled VLM baselines.
papers.resultZh: 与标准的启用搜索的VLM基线相比，显著提高了引文有效性，并减少了知识密集型查询中的幻觉。
